name: Welcome Back Nights
text: Two evenings for parents at the start of the year: Year 6 to Secondary first, then Early Years and Primary. Teachers show how their lessons run, what homework looks like and how they keep in touch with families.

name: Mid-Autumn Festival
text: Every class took the stage: a Nursery catwalk, lantern songs and dances, a play written by Year 6 and a dance from the secondary students.
Then the older students ran the booths: henna, charcoal portraits, mask making, carnival games and a mooncake workshop, next to a charity thrift shop. 54 parents came, far more than we planned for.

name: Halloween
text: Each class turned a broken umbrella into a giant spider. On the 31st: a costume parade, carnival games, and three rooms run by the secondary students for the younger classes, with shadow puppets, marshmallows on strings and apple bobbing.

name: Christmas Talent Show and Market
text: Fourteen acts: class songs and dances, piano solos, gymnastics, a Rubik’s Cube act, a comedy skit and a song from our French teacher.
Downstairs, students sold the cookies, hot chocolate, fruit skewers, kimonos and stockings they had made. The money went to flood relief kits for families in Đà Nẵng, through Da Nang Go.

name: March Mathness
text: Maths games, one topic a week. Guess when a minute is up, then sprint. Mark where 15 metres ends with a piece of chalk. Guess the pom-poms in the jar. Then maze puzzles, stick games and cube towers, with stickers for the winners.

name: Reading Safari Week
text: Roll-the-dice stories, a book cover contest in art class, a costume parade and Drop Everything And Read at lunch. It ended with a reading festival of word games: Articulate, Pictionary, charades, Codenames and Scrabble.

name: Learning Without Walls
when: The last two weeks of the year
text: Class moved off campus. Sports day and a pool party, an afternoon on An Bàng beach, the Kim Bồng carpentry village, a peanut butter workshop, the 3D art museum in Đà Nẵng and a visit to an elderly home. Year 6 camped overnight.

name: Graduation
text: Two ceremonies: Early Years to Year 5 in the morning, then Year 6 to the teens. Every class performed, from a Nursery rainbow song to a periodic table song from the secondary students, and every student went home with a certificate.
